result AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    CASE WHEN (side = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal) OR (side = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal) THEN 'win'
         WHEN (side = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal) OR (side = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal) THEN 'loss'
         ELSE 'draw' END as match_result
  FROM player_matches
  WHERE home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
player_stats AS (
  SELECT player_api_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_result = 'win') as win_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_result = 'loss') as loss_count
  FROM result
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
top_win AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, win_count
  FROM player_stats
  ORDER BY win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
top_loss AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, loss_count
  FROM player_stats
  ORDER BY loss_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  pw.player_name as winning_player,
  tw.win_count as winning_matches,
  pl.player_name as losing_player,
  tl.loss_count as losing_matches
FROM top_win tw
JOIN Player pw ON pw.player_api_id = tw.player_api_id
CROSS JOIN top_loss tl
JOIN Player pl ON pl.player_api_id = tl.player_api_id

  FROM player_matches

),
player_stats AS (

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE match_result = 'win') as win_count,

  FROM result
  GROUP BY player_api_id
)
